sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase year table: a new first column, Event, holds each entry's whole name, for example "1985-01-13 - Carolina Coliseum, Columbia, SC", linked to the entry's page. Venue, city and country are written the way their own columns write them, and pointing at the name shows it as the wiki writes it. Event is now the column that stays in view when you scroll sideways (Date was before), and it always shows the whole name on one line.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The 🖼 gallery on Discogs, the Springsteen sites and Brucebase can now be moved by its title bar (by touch too) and resized from its lower-right corner, like the window Space opens. It reopens where you left it, at that size, kept inside the browser window. Until you have moved or resized it once, it still opens under its 🖼 button. Its position and size go with the config export, as the other panels' do.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Brucebase year table: the Media column is now the second column, right after Date. Before, it came after Notes at the far right, so you had to scroll sideways to see an entry's icons.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Space on a hovered image now does what a click does: it opens the artwork viewer, instead of scrolling the page under the card. This works on Discogs' Image column, the Springsteen sites' image cells and Brucebase's Media icons, and on MusicBrainz's artwork icons, relationship-list covers, the images of an expanded cell and the sidebar cover. It works even when the card is switched off or still loading. On a card with more images than it shows, Space still shows them all first, as before. Space keeps its usual meaning while you type into a field, or with Shift, Ctrl, Alt or ⌘ held.
The image card says so: its bottom line reads "Click or Space: viewer". On a card with more images than it shows, it stays "Click: viewer", because there Space shows the rest of the images.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Brucebase year table: the Setlist icon in the Media column is now ringed like Photo, Ticket, News and Memorabilia when the entry has a page of its own. Pointing at it shows the handwritten setlists from that page (two on 1985-01-13, Columbia, SC), and a click opens them in the viewer. Before, the icon stayed plain, and the page's setlist images were counted as "Other".
A ringed Media icon no longer shows the browser's own name tooltip on top of its image card. With the card switched off, the icon's name still shows on hover.
